chapters.title: 2018 & 2022 fMRI: Your Brain Is an Accountant
How Tiny Kept Promises Rebuild Habit Trust

shorts_extract.hook: Why late-night habit crashes aren't weak willpower — they're rational distrust.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Kidd, Palmeri & Aslin (2013) breaking vs keeping an art-supply promise before the Marshmallow Test.
shorts_extract.twist: Wait times jumped from 3 minutes to 12 minutes, and 2022 fMRI proved the prefrontal cortex prices reliability, not brute grit.
